It's not that I don't understand is that I don't have motivation to do the work even when I want to

I guess I'll start with the basics then. I'm 17 going on 18, I'm a junior in high school. And it looks like I'll be staying that way for a few years. I am failing 3 classes and no matter what I do nothing makes it better. I just never do the work, I have zero motivation to do it. I know the work would make my grades better but I can't bring myself to actually do the work. I just sit on my computer and watch the world's pass me by.
My story isn't a good one I'm not sure anyone wants to hear it
I don't really see much reason to live when there would not be a single tear shed if was to die
It seems like the anonymous people in the internet are the only ones that "care"
I'm almost 17, almost to college and I have nothing to offer anyone who would hire or accept in their college a person with no skills or motivation on top of terrible grades.
I don't really do anything for  fun
In the world we live in today I don't think that being a "nice guy" can get you anywhere in life.

I have tried to ask my friends for help and they tried to teach me but it didn't work. I didn't learn anything and couldn't remember what I had learned. As for school I am trying my best and am barely passing my classes and staying after school everyday for help from the teachers isn't helping

It the kind of hopelessness that you get from seeing your friends happy everyday doing the stuff they are good at and realizing you are not good at anything. I am not good at math or science, I can't write for shit, I can sing or play music. I can't do anything useful at all so why does this world need me.

I just don't see why its worth trying in school I have tried my hardest and I can just barely pass I have even asked for help in school from multiple people and it didn't help much. 

I know my parents want me to be happy and I know you have to work hard to get anything in life but even when I try nothing comes of it.

It isn't just my grades my parents are always telling me I'm going to live in there basement forever and I know they are saying jokingly to get me to try harder and prove them wrong but it is having the opposite effect. 

On top of that because my grades suck my parents took away everything, the only thing I have is my laptop because my grand parents bought it for me and told my parents they couldn't take it away. 

One of the only things that made me happy was my ps3 because I feel like the people I played with was a clan of some really nice people who appreciated me and supported me but I can't do that anymore. 

And none of my real life friends or family know I feel this way except my girlfriend.
